title: Biological Foundation Models - Researcher Index
description: A curated, filterable catalog of foundation models and related resources for biological sequences, molecules, structures, omics, cells, and tissue images.

provenance: Curated from primary papers, official repositories, model hubs, project pages, and explicit licence or access terms. The 2026-07-13 review covered 377 source-audited candidates. The 2026-08-13 refresh ran delegated discovery across all ten modalities, verified every candidate against primary sources, and re-reviewed all 32 under-review records, promoting three of them. The 390 records meeting the release policy form the canonical displayed catalog; 39 unresolved candidates are preserved losslessly in a separate under-review register. Generated distributions come from the canonical JSON through a deterministic build.
evidence_statement: Every displayed record carries an evidence-verification date. The displayed catalog contains 390 records: 252 verified and 138 verified with visible limitations. The 2026-08-13 refresh verified new records and promotions from primary papers, official repositories, model hubs, and exact licence wording, and re-checked every held candidate. 39 unresolved candidates are excluded from the index and preserved with stable IDs, evidence, reasons, and reconsideration conditions in the repository's under-review register.
